agent.name: growth-experiment-runner
agent.purpose: Score active acquisition experiments daily on the channel-mix model and recommend allocation shifts. Recommendations are human-gated — the agent never moves spend on its own.

invariants: No autonomous spend. Recommendations require human approval before any channel allocation changes.
Experiments that breach their stop-loss threshold are halted by the agent and an event is emitted; resumption requires human action.

moduleConsumes.usage: downstream conversion signal for top-of-funnel experiments
distinguish low-quality from high-quality acquired cohorts

hitlConstraints: No autonomous spend. Allocation recommendations require human approval before any change to channel budgets.

moduleExposes.description: Acquisition velocity, channel mix, experiment outcomes
